title: Phantom Blade Zero Release Date - October 29, 2026 (PS5 & PC)
description: Phantom Blade Zero releases October 29, 2026 on PS5 and PC. The confirmed date, platforms, and the full history of the September 9 delay explained.

sections.title: Confirmed Release Date: October 29, 2026
sections.content:
Phantom Blade Zero launches on October 29, 2026 for PlayStation 5 and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store). This date comes directly from S-GAME's own published game information.

Note that many third-party sites still list September 9, 2026. That was the original date, and it is now out of date — the game was moved to October 29 in June 2026. If you see a page claiming a September 9 release, it has not been updated since the delay.

sections.title: Platforms and Editions
sections.content:
PlatformStatusStorefront
PlayStation 5ConfirmedPlayStation Store
Windows PCConfirmedSteam, Epic Games Store

S-GAME has announced the game for PlayStation 5 and PC. No Xbox version has been announced. The game is a single-player action RPG with no multiplayer component announced.

sections.title: Why the Date Moved from September 9 to October 29
sections.content:
The September 9 date was not arbitrary. According to S-GAME, the 9/9 symbolism was deliberate: it represents a reversal of fate and the overturning of heaven's order, echoing the game's central 66-day premise. It was announced on stage at The Game Awards in December 2025.

In June 2026, S-GAME announced the move to October 29, 2026. The stated reason was to allow additional time to further improve the quality of the product.

sections.title: What Is Actually Known Before Launch
sections.content:
Because the game has not shipped, it is worth being precise about what is confirmed and what is not. A number of sites publish detailed boss strategies, weapon stat tables, and "hands-on impressions" for Phantom Blade Zero. Treat those with scepticism — the game is not out, so nobody has played the finished release.

Confirmed by S-GAME and reputable press: the release date, platforms, protagonist and story premise, the Sha-chi combat resource, the blade and Phantom Edge weapon structure, the Kenji Tanigaki action direction, and the studio's own background.

Not confirmed: exact weapon counts, exact boss counts, full ending count and ending conditions, stat tables, and any "best build" ranking. These depend on the shipped build and can only be verified after October 29.

This page and the rest of this site stick to the first category, and label anything in the second as unconfirmed rather than presenting it as tested fact.

sections.title: What to Do Before October 29
sections.content:
If you are waiting for the game, there is a reasonable amount of official material to work through in the meantime:

  • Read the protagonist and story premise — the 66-day setup is the core of the game and shapes everything
  • Understand the Sha-chi combat system before launch so the mechanics are not new to you on day one
  • Look at the studio background — S-GAME's history explains why the game looks the way it does
  • Wishlist on Steam or the PlayStation Store so you get notified at launch
